rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A secure SSH fleet orchestrator built by Samer Farida that provides policy-enforced command execution across multiple servers through MCP tools. The implementation features a deny-by-default security model with IP allowlisting, command pattern matching, host key verification, and audit logging, while supporting both key-based and password authentication with Docker secrets integration. It includes tools for host discovery, command planning with dry-run capabilities, single-host and tag-based batch execution, real-time streaming output with cancellation support, and hot-reloadable configuration, making it useful for infrastructure automation, compliance-aware server management, and AI-assisted DevOps workflows where security and auditability are paramount.
